data.title: Walmart’s Black Friday Deals Continue. Meta’s Muse Can Now Shop Them, Too.
data.summary: Subscribe to Walmart News Alerts Get Walmart corporate news delivered to your inbox. Black Friday shopping has come a long way from lining up outside stores before sunrise. This year, there’s a new way to shop Walmart’s deals: Put an AI agent to work. Starting today, customers can shop Walmart’s Black Friday deals directly through Muse, Meta’s personal AI agent, which can help them find items, build a basket and complete their purchase. [...] Related Stories New Ways to Shop, Holiday Traditions to Keep: Walmart is Ready for the Season Walmart is ready for Holiday 2026 with new ways to shop, including Express Pickup, faster delivery options, accessible services, and holiday traditions customers count on. Walmart Unwraps Three Major Holiday Shopping Events, Bringing Big Savings on Gifts and Seasonal Favorites [...] However customers choose to shop, they can count on the same great prices, assortment, convenience and trusted experience they expect from Walmart. And Muse is just the beginning. The Walmart Agent Gateway will make it possible to shop Walmart through more apps and agents, with additional experiences on the way. This Black Friday, you can hunt for the deals in stores and online, as well as with Sparky, Muse and agents. Either way, Walmart is ready to help you save. Related Stories

data.title: Walmart, Amazon Face Surprising Shopping Shift
data.summary: Meanwhile, Salesforce data showed November discounts were 8% deeper than last year, pushing average merchandise selling prices 1% lower. AI-assisted shopping is also gaining momentum. Walmart CEO John Furner recently revealed that customers using its AI shopping assistant, Sparky, spent 40% more per order than other shoppers. Amazon CEO Andy Jassy reported that American customers using Alexa spent 50% more than nonusers. Investors Takeaway [...] Adobe expects Black Friday online spending to jump 9.2% to $12.9 billion, followed by $15.1 billion on Cyber Monday. However, strong headline sales may conceal growing pressure on retailer profitability. Walmart's exposure to essential merchandise could give it a competitive advantage over discretionary-focused retailers such as Target (NYSE:TGT). Investors should closely monitor merchandise mix, comparable sales, gross margins and inventory levels in upcoming quarterly reports. [...] Walmart, Amazon Face Surprising Shopping Shift This article first appeared on GuruFocus. Americans are increasingly using Black Friday discounts to stock up on everyday necessities rather than simply splurging on holiday gifts, signaling a shift in consumer spending that could favor retail giants Walmart (NASDAQ:WMT) and Amazon (NASDAQ:AMZN) while putting pressure on retailers heavily dependent on discretionary purchases.
